text.p: Southwest Securities Group Inc and CyclOPSS Corp said Wednesday they had agreed that Southwest will act as the exclusive investment banker for CyclOPSS.
Southwest will provide a full range of investment banking functions for CyclOPSS, including acquisition of capital and strategic planning, the companies said.

CyclOPSS has not previously had the services of a full service investment banker. The company said it expects to grow during the next year from the commercialization and market acceptance of its technologies.
It said the expectations "dictated that we search out and retain a firm which can assist us in attaining our goals within the investment markets as well."
